countVotes(uint256).details: Vote weighting: a delegate who voted counts for `delegatePower + 1` votes (their own      citizen vote plus one per citizen who delegated to them). A non-delegate counts for 1.      Reverts if the proposal is not in ENDED status.

params.proposalId: The ID of the proposal to tally (must be in ENDED status).

createProposal(string,string,uint8).details: Caller must own a valid passport. The previous proposal must be in ENDED status before      a new one can be created. Delegates to SixRProposal.create.

params._category: Domain category of the proposal (ECOLOGY, EDUCATION, ECONOMY, DEFENSE).

returns._0: The ID of the newly created proposal.

mintPassport(address,string,string,strin.details: Only callable by the owner (admin). Each address can only hold one passport.      Delegates to SixRPassport.safeMint.

params.birthDate: Date of birth (free-form string, format not enforced on-chain).
params.to: The address of the citizen receiving the passport.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

startVoting(uint256).details: Pausing the passport prevents delegation modifications during the voting period.      The proposal must be in CREATED status and past its PREPARATION_PERIOD.

params.proposalId: The ID of the proposal to transition to ONGOING status.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

voteProposal(uint256,uint8).details: Requires the caller to own a valid passport and not have delegated their vote.      If the voting period has expired at the time of the call, the proposal is automatically      closed, the passport is unpaused, and an ElectionResult event is emitted.

params.proposalId: The ID of the proposal to vote on.
params.vote: The vote choice. Must be YES or NO (NULL is rejected).

returns._0: True if the vote was successfully cast; false if the voting period had expired and         the proposal was closed instead.

constructor.notice: Deploys and initializes the SixRPassport and SixRProposal sub-contracts.

countVotes(uint256).notice: Counts and returns the weighted vote results for a closed proposal.

createProposal(string,string,uint8).notice: Creates a new proposal on behalf of the calling citizen.

mintPassport(address,string,string,strin.notice: Mints a new SixRPassport SBT for a citizen.

passport().notice: The SixRPassport contract instance managing citizen identity (SBT) and delegation.

proposal().notice: The SixRProposal contract instance managing proposal lifecycle and votes.

startVoting(uint256).notice: Opens the voting period for a given proposal and pauses SixRPassport state changes.

voteProposal(uint256,uint8).notice: Casts a vote on an ongoing proposal on behalf of the calling citizen.
